taste.name: Copy rides on the photo
taste.trigger: When the first screen has to say what this week is about
taste.decision: Chose a 0.81:1 portrait photo card with a 2-line headline, hashtag pills and a 'N월 BEST' badge printed over the image over a text title above a separate thumbnail
taste.reason: Because a person deciding where to go on a date scans pictures first; the photo is the argument and the words only name it
evidence: headline '이번 주 어디서 놀지? 이색 놀거리코스 모음' over the image

taste.name: Every card carries a number that says why now
taste.trigger: When a place is listed in a row of similar places
taste.decision: Chose discount %, price and '최근 N명이 구매' on every deal card over descriptive copy about the place
taste.reason: Because the reader's question is 'is this worth it today', and a number answers faster than an adjective

taste.name: Accent only where a value or a hook is
taste.trigger: When choosing where the brand teal goes
taste.decision: Chose to put #0FD3D8 only on discount % and on the first word of each section heading ('여기로 놀러 갈까?', '카테고리로 나눴어요', '가격대별 BEST') over teal buttons, fills or section backgrounds
taste.reason: Because a color that marks only the hook word teaches the eye where to look in every section
evidence: teal is 54 text uses, 0.2% of background area
pale #EFF8FF only behind the cinema promo

taste.name: No shadows, no borders on cards (restraint)
taste.trigger: When separating dozens of cards on a white page
taste.decision: Chose 12px-radius photos and 4–12px spacing to separate items over card containers with shadows or outlines
taste.reason: Because the photos already have edges; a frame around a framed picture adds noise
evidence: 3 box-shadows on the whole page, all on modals
